canonical_statement: Human cognitive faculties and fundamental needs remain consistent across disparate temporal and geographical contexts.

attributions.surface_quote: The primitive needs of man are everywhere the same, and the powers of mind are the same.

canonical_statement: Material artifacts serve as enduring manifestations of human history and consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: Pottery is an enduring evidence of the past history of man.

canonical_statement: Human nature is characterized by a fundamental, universal consistency across all historical periods and geographical locations.

attributions.surface_quote: the nature of man is much the same also

canonical_statement: The diversity observed in the material world and human expression is a reflection of an inherent, universal drive for variety.

attributions.surface_quote: a distinguishing feature in his nature is love of variety

canonical_statement: The natural world possesses an inherent tendency to preserve specific types or forms, acting as a counter-force to change.

attributions.surface_quote: nature, 'so careful of the type.'

canonical_statement: The physical world originates from a primeval, undifferentiated aquatic state.

attributions.surface_quote: The whole earth was believed to have grown out of a primeval deep.

canonical_statement: Civilization and higher knowledge are introduced to humanity by external, non-human entities.

attributions.surface_quote: Oannes or Ea... had risen each morning... bringing with him the elements of civilization.

canonical_statement: The development of cultural and linguistic systems is fundamentally linked to the religious or magical frameworks of a civilization.

attributions.surface_quote: The belief that he was the originator of Babylonian culture may have had its source in the system of magic

canonical_statement: The symbolic representations of a culture reflect the primary environmental and spiritual preoccupations of its originators.

attributions.surface_quote: the spirit of the deep must have been a chief object of worship at the time when the primitive hieroglyphs were first formed

canonical_statement: Life is fundamentally defined by the capacity for motion.

attributions.surface_quote: spirit, a word properly signifying life which manifested itself in the power of motion.

canonical_statement: All entities, including inanimate objects and natural phenomena, possess an inherent life force or spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: All things that moved were possessed of life, and there was a spirit of water.

canonical_statement: The divine is not necessarily anthropomorphic but can be manifested through natural objects or locations.

attributions.surface_quote: It was the town itself that was divine, not the deity.

canonical_statement: Anthropomorphic conceptions of the divine are a projection of human identity and social structure onto the transcendent.

attributions.surface_quote: The gods have become men and women... they live and act like the men.

canonical_statement: The nature of the divine is anthropomorphically projected from human social and political structures.

attributions.surface_quote: the gods he worships conform to the social conditions under which he lives

canonical_statement: Political sovereignty is a manifestation of divine authority, establishing a reciprocal relationship between the earthly ruler and the divine realm.

attributions.surface_quote: the earthly king receives his power and attributes from the god

canonical_statement: The human individual can embody the divine nature through the office of kingship.

attributions.surface_quote: the human king should take upon him the divine nature

canonical_statement: The deification of a sovereign is a necessary corollary of an anthropomorphic conception of deity.

attributions.surface_quote: deification of the sovereign... the necessary corollary of an anthropomorphic conception of the deity

canonical_statement: Spiritual influence over the non-physical world is derived from the mastery of ritualistic spells.

attributions.surface_quote: because he had once been a master of spells that the priest... could influence the spiritual world

canonical_statement: The existence of identical symbolic representations across geographically isolated civilizations suggests a non-accidental, underlying structural or archetypal connection.

attributions.surface_quote: curious similarity in a few instances which it is difficult to interpret as merely accident.

canonical_statement: The capacity for resurrection is a specific divine attribute associated with particular deities rather than a universal feature of the afterlife.

attributions.surface_quote: It is only in connection with Asari that we hear of a possibility that the dead may live again.

canonical_statement: The human soul or consciousness may exist in a diminished, shadowy state after death in the absence of specific divine intervention.

attributions.surface_quote: a shadowy existence in a subterranean land of darkness where all things are forgotten

canonical_statement: Existence is preceded by a primordial state of non-being characterized by the absence of heaven, earth, humanity, divinity, and death.

attributions.surface_quote: At that time the heaven was not, the earth was not, men did not exist.

canonical_statement: The human form is a reflection of the divine nature, facilitating the identification of earthly rulers as incarnate deities.

attributions.surface_quote: where man was made in the image of God, it was easy to see in him a god on earth.

canonical_statement: The perception of historical reality is subject to the projection of contemporary cultural knowledge onto the past.

attributions.surface_quote: compilers of the story... projected the knowledge and usages of their own time back into the past.

canonical_statement: The creator deity Ptah is the origin of the world.

attributions.surface_quote: Ptah, the creator of the world.

canonical_statement: Physical objects can serve as consecrated vessels or dwellings for divine entities.

attributions.surface_quote: the divinity whose home it had become by consecration with oil.

canonical_statement: The distinction between a fetish and a shrine represents a developmental shift in religious consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: the belief that the stone was not a fetish, but the shrine of divinity, belonged to an age of reflection

canonical_statement: Composite mythological beings represent early manifestations of creative power within Babylonian cosmology.

attributions.surface_quote: They represented the first attempts of the creative power, as conceived of by Babylonian cosmology.

canonical_statement: Human cultural and intellectual development is a continuous lineage inherited from ancestral civilizations.

attributions.surface_quote: We are children of our fathers, and amongst our spiritual fathers must be reckoned the Babylonians.

canonical_statement: The sovereign is the essential source of life for all beings in the world.

attributions.surface_quote: the king in the sight of whom all the world lives

canonical_statement: The monarch is elevated to the status of a divine being.

attributions.surface_quote: Deification of king

canonical_statement: The divine hierarchy is structured through genealogical relationships, such as the Moon-god being the son of the god of Nippur.

attributions.surface_quote: The Moon-god of Ur was a “son” of El-lil, the god of Nippur.

canonical_statement: Certain locations possess an ontological status of 'everlasting' or primordial existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Sippara that is from everlasting

canonical_statement: The ka, or vital essence of an individual, maintains a distinct existence that can be represented and sustained through symbolic ritual offerings.

attributions.surface_quote: the ka of the person... is seated on a chair... an altar with offerings
